content.text:
What specific improvements would you like me to make? The file is an interactive circle display with nice styling and functionality. I can help with:

- **Performance optimizations** (CSS, animations, event handling)
- **Code quality** (refactoring, removing redundancy)
- **Features** (additional interactions, more color modes, animations)
- **UX improvements** (better visual feedback, clearer hints, mobile experience)
- **Accessibility** (enhanced keyboard support, screen reader support)
- **Visual design** (different colors, themes, layout changes)

Or I can make general improvements across multiple areas—just let me know what matters most to you.
